title: Beartown
author: Fredrik Backman
summary: A struggling Swedish forest town pins its hopes on its junior ice hockey team. After a terrible act involving the team's star player, the whole community is forced to choose between loyalty and the truth.
readIf: you like emotional, character-heavy stories about community and what people will excuse for a win.
skipIf: you are not ready for a serious treatment of sexual assault or want a light sports story.
